original_test_intent: Boot into the approved UEFI Shell, execute the platform-supported SMBIOS display command, and compare every project-required SMBIOS field against the owner specification.
original_method: Confirm the exact shell command and fields, boot the approved shell, capture the complete read-only SMBIOS output, compare it with the SPEC and optional OS inventory, exit without writes, and restore normal boot.
manual_activity: A human must boot the pre-OS shell, enter the documented command and observe/capture its output. OS inventory can corroborate fields but cannot replace shell-command execution.
required_inputs: Required SMBIOS types/fields and expected values
safety_requirements: Do not guess among `smbios view`, `smbiosview` or `smbiosdump`.
Run only the documented read-only display command.
Approve the shell boot path and avoid unapproved storage access.
Preserve complete raw output rather than selected screenshots only.
Stop on wrong command/media, incomplete output or boot failure; restore normal boot.
agent_execution_scope: Collect OS-side read-only SMBIOS inventory and platform identity for comparison.
Parse the operator's complete shell output into a field matrix.
Review the mismatched project-script path and report applicability without claiming shell execution or verdict.
engineer_actions: Confirm exact command, required fields, expected values and script applicability.
Boot/capture the UEFI Shell command and restore normal boot.
Resolve cross-view differences and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The pre-OS boundary is correct, but smbiosdump is not in the source and cannot be proposed without platform documentation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve both source spellings until the platform shell guide identifies the valid one. Do not assume the URL ending basic_command_version implements SMBIOS coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Procedure `smbios view`, Criteria `smbiosview`, original script URL and 10/10-minute fields are all preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture complete shell SMBIOS output and full OS readback, retain structure handles/types, and compare only owner-required fields with approved normalization.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact UEFI Shell and SMBIOS implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, shell, SMBIOS spec level, OS tool and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform shell command guide and owner SMBIOS field specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact-command provenance, complete output and structured comparison without replacing the shell target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different renderers may format the same table differently; raw handles/types must be retained.

project_override_considerations: Projects define applicable SMBIOS fields and approved normalization. They must explicitly resolve the command/script mismatch and cannot substitute OS-only output for UEFI Shell coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, approved command and field/SPEC list
Optional complete OS inventory plus field-by-field comparison
Normal boot restoration, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure names `smbios view`, Criteria names `smbiosview`, and the Script URL points to basic_command_version rather than an SMBIOS-specific path. These source fields disagree on the exact implementation, although the SMBIOS inspection intent is clear.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A platform shell guide and script inspection can select the supported spelling without changing the clear SMBIOS-read intent. This is an execution-readiness conflict, not an irreducible block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains MANUAL ONLY but rejects its undocumented smbiosdump alternative.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its command-confirmation, field-map and recovery improvements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds the mismatched script provenance and distinguishes SOURCE_CONFLICT from permanent BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents a guessed command alias or the adjacent version script from being reported as execution of this SMBIOS case, while preserving a viable documented path.
independent_technical_reasoning: The target data and acceptance are identifiable, so the spelling/script inconsistency does not justify BLOCKED. Core execution still occurs interactively in pre-OS UEFI Shell, making MANUAL ONLY correct.
no_automatic_retry: Do not try alternate spellings or rerun automatically after an error; preserve the response and obtain platform-owner disposition.
